reason: Reading every Instance's layout at the revision it runs over a Component at rest (ComponentPlan.RunnersFor, as the create pass reads each planned Instance and as BuildPlan builds each entry), at 1,000 and 4,000 single-pod Instances, 160 gangs of a leader and seven workers and 1,725 gangs of a leader and one worker; the spec revision records the gang's width and every Instance renders it. The layout is read in place: the plan's own layout, or the Instance's entry when the plan carries none, is handed back when the revision changes no width in it, and copied at the recorded width otherwise, so at rest the reading allocates nothing. Before, the layout was copied for every Instance whether or not the revision changed a width in it: 1,000 / 4,000 / 160 / 1,725 allocations and 24,000 / 96,000 / 7,680 / 82,800 bytes at the four shapes, recorded on the same day and machine.
